payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about the performance of multilingual BERT (M-Bert) in various settings, including cross-lingual and cross-target scenarios, as well as its general performance in stance detection tasks.

claims.text: M-Bert performs better than majority class baselines in cross-lingual and cross-target settings, although its performance is lower than in supervised settings.
M-Bert has established itself as state-of-the-art for various multilingual tasks and can generalize across languages to some extent.
The model's performance in zero-shot transfer is possible but indicates room for improvement, with a drop in mean scores compared to supervised settings.
